signals.rationale: The speaker's brows are deeply furrowed and his facial expression is tense as he speaks. His voice is sharp and elevated in pitch, and he uses harsh language, stating, "What a scoundrel," which clearly indicates annoyance and frustration.
The speaker maintains steady eye contact and an upright posture while delivering his message. His voice is clear and steady, and he speaks fluently without any filler words or hesitation.
